uploadHint: Files stay on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
patternIntro: Explore layouts, component composition and working interactions. All data is local mock data.
listLayoutHelp: Use a stacked list for general queries. Add a left tree or menu for persistent scope. Keep previews in a side sheet.
listComponentHelp: Tabs select status, Select filters fixed values, Checkbox enables batches, Table supports comparison, and Sheet preserves context.
listInteractionHelp: Changing scope or status resets pagination and selection. Search, sort and paginate results; create records in a focused form.
settingsHelp: Settings use a focused grouped form. Keep scope, unsaved changes and save feedback close to the fields.
decisionNeeded: Enter a decision note of at least 3 characters.
reviewDescription: Review the request and its impact, then record your decision.
uploaded: Added to the current resource list
localOnly: Changes stay on this page and reset on refresh.
settingsDescription: Manage workspace configuration, notifications and processing preferences.
approvalImpact: Affects scheduling and resource allocation. Completed milestones remain unchanged.

dashboard.layout: Manufacturing ERP: metrics, trend, task queue, exceptions and recent documents. Procurement, inventory, production and finance are peer views.
dashboard.component: Tabs organize tasks; Card groups metrics; Table compares records; Progress shows receipt and output; Sheet and Dialog handle previews and confirmation.
dashboard.interaction: Tasks and exceptions navigate to business views. Filter purchase orders by warehouse, status and text. Receipt updates order status and open purchase value, preventing repeats.

listing.layout: Stacked list, tree-and-list for persistent scope, or category-and-list.
listing.component: Accordion, Tabs, Input, Select, Popover, TanStack with shadcn Table, Checkbox and paging buttons.
listing.interaction: Scope and status reset page and selection; query, sort, paginate, bulk update and open editor.

recordDetail.layout: Object summary and primary action above same-object tabs.
recordDetail.component: Tabs, Progress, definition lists, Badge, timeline, Dialog and disclosure.
recordDetail.interaction: Return to the list; inspect activity; validate and save a focused edit.

entryForm.layout: Single-page capture, grouped editing, or a sequential wizard.
entryForm.component: React Hook Form with Zod, Input, Textarea, Checkbox and dynamic deliverables.
entryForm.interaction: Validate fields, add and remove rows, preserve steps and retry failed submissions.

preferences.layout: Left settings navigation and a focused form on the right.
preferences.component: Input, Switch, Slider, RadioGroup, Accordion, Alert and a submit button.
preferences.interaction: Switch sections, adjust options and thresholds, validate fields and show save results.

reviewDesk.layout: Left request queue with detail, impact and decision controls on the right.
reviewDesk.component: Avatar, Badge, Progress, timeline, Dialog and Textarea.
reviewDesk.interaction: Select requests; require a decision note; update queue status and prevent duplicate decisions.

reporting.layout: Metric strip, primary trend, side distribution and record summaries.
reporting.component: Card, Select, Tabs, line and bar charts, Progress distribution and Badge.
reporting.interaction: Change the date range and chart mode; navigate to record details.

assets.layout: Left resource categories, file list and a contextual preview Sheet.
assets.component: Input, local file input, shadcn Table, Sheet, Tabs and file icons.
assets.interaction: Combine search with category filters, add local files and preview without losing list context.

workViews.layout: Board, Gantt and calendar show the same work in three rhythms: stage, timeline and daily agenda.
workViews.component: Drag-and-drop board cards, DropdownMenu card actions, Gantt progress bars with Tooltip, and a linked calendar agenda panel.
workViews.interaction: Drag updates the stage immediately with an aria-live result; the card menu also moves and duplicates cards; selecting a day filters the agenda.

interactionLab.layout: A dense lab grid: commands and feedback first, rich content and precise data below.
interactionLab.component: Command palette dialog, toast stack, the production MDXEditor, inline table rows, donut and area SVG charts, and tag input.
interactionLab.interaction: ⌘K opens the palette; filtering and arrow keys navigate. Toasts auto-dismiss, inline edits validate before saving, and charts respond to the range switch.
